report.explanation: All admitted telemetry is healthy: order checkout trace OK at 71ms, error_rate 0.001, p95 72ms, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters, INFO 200 logs, and a valid config deployed 1464 minutes ago. No observation supports any taxonomy cause, and the deployment record alone cannot establish latency. The alert's degraded checkout health is unconfirmed by current evidence, so no bounded candidate can be substantiated; hand off for further evidence.
missing_evidence: Telemetry showing actual checkout degradation (elevated error rate or p95 latency) in the alert window; current metrics show error_rate 0.001 and p95 72ms across services.
Traces spanning the full checkout path with downstream spans to localize any latency or failure.
Evidence of dependency timeouts, db pool waiters, or resource saturation to test db-pool-exhaustion or downstream-latency.
Memory-retention time series per service to test memory-leak; single snapshot is insufficient.
Configuration change records or error logs to test bad-configuration or http-500.
